ar.title: سلطة المكرونة الملونة
ar.intro:
مكرونة بأشكال ممتعة مع خضار بكل الألوان.

أضف تونة أو زيتوناً لسلطة أكبر.

steps.n1: شخص كبير يسلق المكرونة في ماء بملح حوالي 10 دقائق.
steps.n2: الشخص الكبير يصفّيها ويشطفها بماء بارد.
steps.n3: شخص كبير يقطع الفلفل والخيار مكعبات.
steps.n4: قطّع الطماطم الشيري أنصافاً بسكين الزبدة.
steps.n5: ضع المكرونة والذرة والجبنة والخضار في السلطانية.

en.title: Colourful Pasta Salad
en.intro:
Fun pasta shapes with vegetables in every colour.

Add tuna or olives for a bigger salad.

steps.n1: A grown-up boils the pasta in salty water for about 10 minutes.
steps.n2: The grown-up drains it and rinses it with cold water.
steps.n3: A grown-up cuts the pepper and cucumber into cubes.
steps.n4: Cut the cherry tomatoes in half with a butter knife.
steps.n5: Put the pasta, corn, cheese and vegetables in the bowl.
steps.n6: Squeeze in the lemon and add the oil and salt.
steps.n7: Stir gently until all the colours are mixed.

legacySteps: A grown-up boils the pasta in salty water for about 10 minutes.
The grown-up drains it and rinses it with cold water.
A grown-up cuts the pepper and cucumber into cubes.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in half with a butter knife.
Put the pasta, corn, cheese and vegetables in the bowl.
Squeeze in the lemon and add the oil and salt.
Stir gently until all the colours are mixed.
